hints: Maintain a window with at most k distinct values using a frequency map.
When adding a value creates k+1 distinct values, advance the left edge until the window is valid again.
For each right endpoint, all starts from left through right give valid subarrays.
analogy: The window tolerates up to k different labels; removing from its left restores that limit.
example: For 1,2,3,1,1 with k=2, valid window counts by endpoint total 10.
algorithm: Use a sliding window with counts and a distinct counter. Shrink while distinct>k; add right-left+1 to a 64-bit answer.
correctness: After shrinking, the maintained window is the longest valid suffix ending at right; every shorter suffix is valid and every earlier start includes too many distinct values.
complexity: O(n) expected time and O(n) space.
